no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Beroni Group is an Australian biopharma whose commercialized products are diagnostic kits (CII-ArboViroPlex, SARS-CoV-2 IgG/IgM, SARS-CoV-2 Antigen). Its therapeutic R&D pipeline (PENAO small molecule oncology, allogeneic gamma-delta T cell, protein modifier R8, DC vaccine adjuvant, coronavirus single-domain antibody) is entirely preclinical per the current corporate R&D page. PENAO had a prior first-generation Phase 1 trial in Australia, but no active company-sponsored Phase 1/2/3 trial is registered on ClinicalTrials.gov.

excluded_preclinical.reason: Currently classified as Pre-Clinical on company R&D page; second-generation manufacturing initiated 2021 but no active CT.gov-registered Phase 1/2/3
